sloka: सङ्ग्रामे तं तथा दृष्ट्वा रावणं तलताडितम् ।ऋषयो वानराः सिद्धा नेदुर्देवाः सहासुरैः ।। ६.५९.६३ ।।।।
transliteration: saṅgrāme taṁ tathā dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṁ talatāḍitam ।ṛṣayo vānarāḥ siddhā nedurdevāḥ sahāsuraiḥ ।। 6.59.63 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.
